parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (AppServices, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (app:iOS, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` structs with an identical two-field shape — `artwork` and `playcut:Playcut` — differing only in the concrete image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). This single differing slot is a textbook candidate for a generic type parameter. Introducing a generic `PlaycutItem<ArtworkImage>` in the `AppServices` package (which both consumers already depend on) eliminates the duplication while letting each call site bind `ArtworkImage` to `Image` or `UIImage` as appropriate. Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, so the duplication is not intentional.
